scenarios.title: Exact sealed launch and raw input
scenarios.procedure: Owned fake CLI records argv/cwd/positive env and raw stdin; prompt contains newlines, Unicode, quotes, shell metacharacters and JSON-looking text. Rehash at guarded physical start. Repeat with each bound identity changed.
scenarios.expected: Valid bytes reach child exactly once, EOF once, no shell interpretation; drift or cancelled/expired/stale fence yields zero child launch. Unknown override/config cannot be admitted. Every -c value must round-trip a real TOML parser with structural equality before admission; a value that would silently degrade to a raw string is rejected pre-spawn (source: #92 F1/F3, codex 0.157.1 @36650394).

scenarios.title: Typed positive controls
scenarios.procedure: Emit fragmented multibyte UTF-8 JSONL: thread.started, turn.started, command started/completed exit0, completed-only file_change, completed reasoning/progress, settled todo, exact final, turn.completed usage; close both streams and exit0; independently observe group.
scenarios.expected: Source-shaped complete control may yield a proposed result only. No invented RPC fields or file_change start required; checks/review/CI remain unverified.

scenarios.title: Framing and bounds
scenarios.procedure: From F02 independently inject invalid UTF-8, duplicate JSON keys, malformed/nonobject JSON, extra unknown fields, oversized prompt/frame/log/item count, final unterminated line and stderr-holder descendant.
scenarios.expected: No accepted success; retain bounded prefix and truncation/unknown reason. Distinguish child decoder EOF from carrier EOF and stderr EOF; stdout final alone cannot establish cleanup.

scenarios.title: Item and terminal contradictions
scenarios.procedure: From F02 inject duplicate/missing thread or turn start, reused IDs/type changes, update-before-start, completed-only command, duplicate item completion, pending/unknown/malformed settlement, actual policy/authority denial or declined command, null exit, started todo_list left unresolved without completion (no ephemeral backfill), duplicate terminal and post-terminal event. A completed todo_list's task state is informational only — exec synthesizes todo completion at turn end regardless of steps done — and is not an injection or rejection class (source: #92 F10, codex 0.157.1 @36650394). Ordinary settled command/patch failures are paired positive controls F12/F13.
scenarios.expected: Each listed protocol/policy contradiction rejects a successful proposal; pending/uncertain lifecycle cannot silently disappear. Completed-only patch/message controls remain accepted. A fully observed ordinary failed item alone is not a protocol/action-failure verdict; its evidence stays retained.

scenarios.title: Final and error authority
scenarios.procedure: Replace final with prose, old/extra/missing schema fields, wrong action/input/role, duplicate schema-shaped final, final before last tool, unknown active tool, error item/event, reroute, turn.failed or missing terminal; test nonzero exit after valid final.
scenarios.expected: Each rejects success; no RPC turn.error assertion inferred. Earlier progress cannot count as final. Reviewer changed/no_code and implementer complete do not pass role outcome checks.

scenarios.title: Start/input crash windows
scenarios.procedure: Kill owner before/after intent persistence, guarded begin, child ownership receipt, attempted-input write, partial input, EOF, final persistence and cancellation. Restart and deliver duplicate/late results with same identity.
scenarios.expected: At most one native start per action; partial/lost start/input reconciles or stays recovery_required, never replay. Prompt consumption is evidenced only by a subsequent thread.started; a pipe-buffered write without it stays attempted-unknown with no resend (source: #92 F9, codex 0.157.1 @36650394). Original deadline and physical identity survive; cancel/stale inputs reject publication.

scenarios.title: Deadline and physical cleanup
scenarios.procedure: Use owned fake child with ignored TERM, held stdout/stderr, owned descendant, lost supervisor and unrelated sentinel. Hit work deadline reserving cleanup time; inject cleanup uncertainty.
scenarios.expected: Bounded TERM/KILL only for exact owned identities; preserve sentinel/logs. Original deadline never restarts. Unknown/escaped descendant keeps slot fenced and result unaccepted; no remote cancellation assertion.

scenarios.title: Terminal usage classification
scenarios.procedure: Emit positive component usage; missing usage; source-default all-zero; interrupted/failed before terminal; negative/fractional/unsafe/inconsistent subset values; positive reasoning/cached subsets.
scenarios.expected: Valid positive usage is native-harness-telemetry, comparison input+output only, actual consumption unknown. Missing/allzero cannot become local-no-model or provider-receipt. Invalid counts reject; allzero stays ambiguous-zero.

scenarios.title: Threshold and overrun
scenarios.procedure: Freeze threshold100 and planning allowance40. Complete an action with reported input80/output40, then separately total99,100,101 and unknown/allzero results. Try every agent work kind plus local checks/CI observation/cleanup.
scenarios.expected: 120 retained unclipped despite planning40; totals>=100 or unresolved usage block every next automatic agent action including CI repair. Total99 permits only otherwise valid finite work. Bounded non-agent operations remain possible; no mid-turn cutoff claim.

scenarios.title: Finite scheduling and CI independence
scenarios.procedure: Exhaust review correction/arbitration/repeated-signature bounds, then observe failing CI and request reserved repair; repeat after unknown usage, reached threshold, elapsed exhaustion, competing starts and resource overflow.
scenarios.expected: Review exhaustion alone cannot spend/block reserved CI attempt; telemetry/deadline can block agent repair honestly. One active slot; counters never reset/refund after crash, revision or uncertainty; repeated unchanged/no-op work stops.

scenarios.title: Nonsecret classification and forged evidence
scenarios.procedure: Inject auth classifications subscription/API/unknown/mismatch/race, raw key fragments, missing effective policy, caller capability=true, altered/missing artifact and stale independent approval. Use owned synthetic values only.
scenarios.expected: Only recognized approved nonsecret classification retained; never raw auth status/key fragments. Mismatch/unknown/race unresolved blocks model launch with no forced login/logout or API fallback. Forged/changed evidence cannot mint admission.

scenarios.title: Failed regression then repair and current proposal
scenarios.procedure: Within one fresh action emit a started/completed regression command with nonzero exit and ordinary diagnostic failure, retain its full bounded result, then source repair and later settled tools, exact changed final, turn.completed with valid reported usage, CLI exit0, both EOFs and independent cleanup. Obtain fresh host-selected current-tree checks. Pair with a mandatory host check that still fails, unresolved diagnostic settlement, and actual policy denial.
scenarios.expected: The ordinary failed regression does not alone reject the correctly bound proposed changed result once all other stream/fence/usage/deadline/cleanup criteria hold. Original failure remains visible. Delivery requires independent current-input passing checks and resolved findings; model prose or a later diagnostic cannot clear the failing host receipt. Unresolved settlement and actual policy denial still reject a successful proposal.

scenarios.title: Recoverable patch mismatch then corrected proposal
scenarios.procedure: Within one fresh action emit a completed-only file_change with ordinary context-mismatch failure, then a distinct-ID corrected patch with observed completed status and current changed final after all tools settle; complete valid usage/terminal/CLI exit0/EOF/cleanup. Pair with a patch denial expressed only through a denial form the pinned 0.157.1 source actually emits for file_change — otherwise route it through error/turn.failed/declined or defer it to N03, never an invented status (source: #89/850(b)) — plus missing patch settlement, fatal turn/error/reroute and nonzero CLI exit; retain all original patch records.
scenarios.expected: The fully observed ordinary patch failure may precede an accepted current proposal; failed and corrected item histories both remain immutable. Trusted current-input checks still decide behavior and delivery. Actual denial, ambiguous/pending operation, fatal/error/reroute or nonzero CLI exit cannot be healed by the later patch/final.

scenarios.title: Pinned identity and actual discovery
scenarios.procedure: Under separate finite authority bind actual binary/helper/platform and source/CLI schema; seed synthetic user/project config/rules, global CODEX_HOME AGENTS/override, ancestor instructions and system/managed/cloud conflicts; test tool discovery and effective role policy.
scenarios.expected: Allowed approved instruction control observed; unapproved instructions/config/routes absent or admission blocked. Ignore flags alone never suffice; unknown keys/nested-map inheritance cannot pass. Shared CODEX_HOME config.toml and approved global instruction bytes rehash unchanged post-run; trust persistence into the shared home is prevented by the explicit untrusted override and a projectless staged tree (source: #92 F5/F6, codex 0.157.1 @36650394). Source-to-binary correspondence is not reproducible attestation.
scenarios.blocker: Separate exact native/live/target authority and preceding gates required.
